incident_summary: 4 open customer requests for Compact Hot-Desk Station (WST-CHD-004); 23 finished units on hand; no in-house manufacturing.

policy.manufacturing: No in-house manufacturing capacity; buy any shortfall beyond on-hand stock.
rules: Fulfill all orders while minimizing new spending on procurement and manufacturing.
The combined units covered through new purchasing or manufacturing must clear at least 27.9% portfolio-level new-spend margin at selling price.
Finance considers the existing stock as sunk cost.
Use 30 Days terms on retained sales orders and all linked customer invoices.

For retained orders with untaxed totals of $2,000.00 or more, first create and post a down payment invoice for 40%; then create and post a regular invoice for the remaining amount. Below that threshold, create and post one regular invoice.
You must create and confirm the necessary sales orders and purchase orders.
Link Sales Orders to the related Purchase Orders for traceability.
For finished-goods purchase orders, list the linked sales order ID(s) (e.g. SO-0003, or SO-0003 and SO-0004) in origin_sales_order_ids.
In the end, the lineage must be SO -> PO.
You must sell this product at List Price.
On sales orders, set the commitment day.
On purchase orders, you must set the planned arrival day.
Before releasing anything, read the notes on stock, customers, and vendors.
No in-house manufacturing capacity is available.
For each finished-goods supplier offer, respect min/max quantities as horizon-wide totals.
Use one consolidated PO per supplier offer (do not split a single offer across multiple POs).
Check each vendor's notes in the ERP for maximum order quantity limits.
